testcase.name: Scenario: Retain compact appearance when switching tabs and cycling display modes: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:59:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain compact appearance when switching tabs and cycling display modes ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Compact appearance ✔ And the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes ✔ When the user selects the Tools tab ✔ Then its ribbon commands use the compact layout ✔ When the user cycles the ribbon through panel buttons, panel titles, and tabs only back to the full ribbon ✔ Then the Tools ribbon commands still use the compact layout ✔ And the Ribbon Appearance submenu marks "Compact" as selected
